title: DnD Battle Arena
description: A fight night for one: pick a crew of four, take two heats and a boss, walk the tent. Rules run on the same engine as the invite-only multiplayer beta.

title: Chart Queue
description: A live claim board for a coding marketplace. Two tabs race for the same chart, a row lock (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) settles who wins, Turbo Streams keep every tab current, and a Sidekiq job releases claims that blow their SLA.

title: Review Workflow
description: A coded chart moves draft → review → returned or approved on an aasm state machine. Reviewers edit codes inline in Turbo Frames, every change lands in a PaperTrail timeline, and keyboard shortcuts drive the review.

title: Coding Assistant + Evals
description: A background job sends a synthetic encounter note to a model through one constrained tool and streams suggested codes back with confidence and the sentence each came from. An Evals tab re-runs a 30-case golden set against any prompt edit and shows the delta.
software: Rails 8 · Sidekiq · Turbo Streams · Claude API

title: Tactical Grid
description: A 3D tactical battle grid built for the phone. Elevation and ramps, line of sight, area-of-effect shapes, and multi-tap moves and attacks.

title: Map Editor
description: Draw a battle map with glyphs, place the party, foes and objects, and export the encounter. System-free, so it works with any ruleset.

title: Character Creator
description: A step-by-step character creation wizard that walks from intent to class, abilities and equipment, with a progress rail that shows how far along you are.

title: Jenna & Travis wedding site
description: Invitation-styled single-page site for our January 2027 wedding. React and TypeScript, deployed on AWS with S3, CloudFront, Route 53 and an ACM certificate.
